move: cards spiral in along a drawn path, fan-stack, unwind out
how: A dashed spiral path (2.25 turns from 1100px radius to centre) is drawn with drawSVG over the first 20% (power2.out) as the title rises from a mask. Four portrait photo cards each ride the path with motionPath from start to end over 1.2s (power3.out), spinning from rotation -540 to 0 and scaling 0.4 to 1 while fading in, launched at 3, 24, 45 and 66% of the 6s loop. As each new card lands, the earlier cards step back into a fanned stack (x/y offsets, +/-7deg, scale minus 4% per depth, expo.out). At 83% the stack bobs up 10px and back (sine.inOut yoyo), then at 89% all cards fling out to the upper right with rotation 540, scale 0.2 and fade (power3.in, 40ms stagger) while the path undraws and the title drops out.
adapt: Replace the four card images and captions, the title, subtitle and footer strings, and the stage/ink colours; card count changes the 1.25s launch cadence. Keep the 2.25-turn spiral, 1.2s power3.out ride and the -540deg spin.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the SVG spiral path (points computed from el size), title and cards inside el. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with MotionPathPlugin and DrawSVGPlugin registered; the path id must be unique per instance (use a generated id or pass the path element) so the motionPath selector does not hit another shot.
caveats: motionPath references #sp by document id; must be unique when scoped to el
final frame is empty stage rather than the initial frame
